cycles.method: Not measured in cycles, waived by the owner for 0.4.2 (sdk/approvals, chip-worst-case-cycles) as for 0.3.0 to 0.4.1. The package's work runs in the frame interrupt on every frame while a host streams: the producer, the packet copy and, while the host plays in, the input receiver and the recording's drift trim (usb_audio_output_trim.c, new in 0.4.2: a four-frame Catmull-Rom slip of the sent words, about 3.4 slips a second). In MAIN + CUE at high speed 0.4.2 does the built-in's work: one flag a frame, no track words, the built-in's sixteen-byte copy. No static bound was counted. The load below is the measured whole cost.

load.method: The owner's Octatrack MKII, development twin 9cf5c4a8 of the 0.8.3 base draft with the USB reset fix (dc9d156a3's source), 27 November 2026, agent-run, a rolled-back trial, nothing kept. Scene: the owner's project, bank C pattern C02 playing, T7 a Thru machine on inputs AB with one trig, the other tracks muted; a Mac connected. Each figure is the base's guard and CPU meter over one 25 s reading. Stock: no module, the longest frame 39.2 % of a 362.8 us frame, the frame interrupt's mean 23.6 %, the CPU meter 35.4 % (idle 64.6). Module: the release (c2597a32) with INPUTS OFF (the default) while the Mac records Main + Cue, two readings: the longest frame 53.0 and 53.4 %, the mean 28.2 and 28.0 %, the CPU meter 45.0 and 40.9 %; the record keeps the higher longest frame and the lower idle (55.0). Installed with no stream: 24.3 %, 47.7 %. With INPUTS AB, on twin 005817e4 the same day in the same scene, recording costs about 1.2 points more of the mean (macOS runs the input stream whenever it records). The built-in original linked into a twin of the same source added 3.2 points of the mean to a recording; this release adds about 4.5 with INPUTS OFF. No late entry, wait or skipped render in any reading. The built-in, recording Main + Cue in the same scene on its own linked twin the same day: the longest frame 60.4 %, the mean 31.1 %, the CPU meter 44.4 % (idle 55.6); that twin also ran 4.3 points above its base at rest, not understood.

stress.droppedExplanation: Not a MIDI flood (the fields stay empty: it does not apply). Instead, on the 0.8.2 development twin 8a341725 with the release installed: every USB AUDIO setting changed idle (13 changes), while the Mac recorded (6) and while it played in (3); the Mac always ended with the right channel count, the Modwerk link came back, no usb incident, no late entry; a change while playing waited for STOP. A 10-minute duplex run on 26 November 2026 (an earlier build of the same trim) stayed clean.
